description: Owner request (2026-10-20): Search Console access for the autopilot through a service account whose key the owner keeps on the server. Bounded probe in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run gsc_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which reads the key, and only GETs/queries Search Console (properties and permission, sitemaps, top queries/pages for 28 days, index status of 7 pages). The key never leaves the server; the report is checked for key material. No application source, CRM, HTML, media or bot state changes; 20 CPU seconds cap. Repeat: run 1 found the key uploaded as .txt (KEY_MISSING); .txt is now accepted.
title: Search Console access probe
